# f5 in the model picker reloads the models in the background, names what it found, and lists it with its layer
resize 140 30
key ctrl+l
wait f5 reloads models
wait 14 models
absent claude-sonnet-5-5
screen
key f5
wait models reload found claude-sub/claude-sonnet-5-5
wait 15 models
screen
type sonnet-5-5
wait layer   catalog
screen
